title: Blockbuster Could Have Bought Netflix For $50 Million. They Laughed Them Out Of The Room.
description:
Educational purposes only. Not financial advice.

In 2000, Netflix co-founders Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph pitched Blockbuster on buying their struggling DVD-by-mail startup for $50 million. Blockbuster's leadership passed. Within a decade Blockbuster was bankrupt, and Netflix went on to become one of the most valuable media companies in the world. (Blockbuster's then-CEO has since disputed how serious the meeting was — this is the widely reported version from Netflix's own founders.)
